desc: The Tisas USA 1911 Carry Night Stalker Bobtail Comp Model modernizes the classic 1911 with enhanced features for superior performance. Designed for personal defense, duty, or range use, it offers power and precision at an exceptional value. The bobtail frame improves concealability, while its upgraded components ensure reliable, accurate shooting. Combining timeless design with modern innovation, the Night Stalker is built for shooters who demand the best.
